additionalResources.category: Agent not involved in module implementation, in a fresh task context with only public docs and tarball
additionalResources.reason: No verified independent Agent/context, frozen prompt, public docs/tarball identity, or intervention log is assigned. This inventory author and implementers cannot self-certify independent use.
additionalResources.recoveryCondition: Assign a fresh non-implementer Agent context per AG task; retain prompt/docs/package hashes, commands, failures, retries and interventions. Restart the task after public documentation fixes.

decisions.missing: The plan names six required platform classes and exact WASM-13 HOST/DEVICE splits, but does not state that every C/I/A/BIZ test runs on every browser or exactly which browser subset applies to each.
decisions.recommendation: Adopt the explicit candidate definition rows: all five real browser classes for public C/I/A behavior, Node plus Chrome for low-level binding/U fixtures, host-only artifact audits, exact HOST/DEVICE splits, three named product devices for performance, and one separately allocated human cohort. Node is not an AIR main-entry or rendering substitute. Keep all six platform classes and every fixed ID. For fixtures introduced before M5, schedule non-host-browser matrix cells at M5 while retaining the original fixture introduction phase; host Chrome/Node keep the source first phase. All positive MT cells first require M6 or later. This staging recommendation does not certify a complete parent at an earlier checkpoint.

decisions.missing: No target-by-target MT positive support decision, exact SIMD/SAB/Worker/browser versions, or feature-by-variant matrix is frozen. workerCount is 2..4, while A06/P03 compare 2 and 4.
decisions.recommendation: Retain positive MT2/MT4 candidates wherever shared behavior is proposed and MT3 for complete legal-count admission, lifetime, platform and repeatability tests. Every MT candidate requires real successful pool/world execution; injected missing-capability multi rejection and permitted auto-to-ST fallback are additional observations, never substitutions. Freeze actual positive target support before G0; do not infer unsupported from current resource failure.

decisions.missing: The source requires critical Debug/Release coverage but does not enumerate critical cases.
decisions.recommendation: Adopt criticalDebugReleaseTestIds exactly as the initial risk-based proposal: ABI, ST isolation, generation, heap growth, binding ownership/snapshot, real binding platform, runtime body setters/damping, contact snapshot/transient sensors/callback destruction, invalid query/setter rollback, complete app close and both real-native U fixtures. Run the entire required fixture in each listed build profile, with separate native artifact identities. Extend through a versioned technical review when risk warrants it.

decisions.blocks: G7 performance freeze; profile/MT applicability is separately decided by D01/D02, not by availability of baselines
decisions.missing: Actual device/power/browser/viewport fingerprints, first correctness-qualified baselines, exact scene/settings hashes, workload and active-window fixture assets, instrumentation overhead and invalid-infrastructure rules remain unestablished; MT applicability is pending D02.
decisions.recommendation: Retain all nine initial profiles and published absolute/regression budgets. Adopt explicit P01–P07 profile rows, desktop 100/500/1000 workloads and mobile 200-body product profiles with separately retained 100/500/1000 pressure observations. IOS-COMPAT carries correctness, not an invented general 60fps guarantee. Freeze all applicable thresholds and measurement identity before optimization/acceptance, not after failures.

decisions.blocks: fixture-ready execution and G0 fixture readiness, not an otherwise defined denominator
decisions.missing: Source assertion text is not a runnable hash-bound fixture. Most exact fixture assets, creation order/settings/seed, sleep wait policy, minimum dimensions, hull/core limits, sweep linearSlop, contact snapshot timing, character normal/push limits and per-joint extreme targets are not frozen here. C16 original geometry/gravity/speed must be recovered or explicitly reconstructed. C14 recovery children have IDs but no complete standalone assertion text in the original plan.
decisions.recommendation: Bind each fixtureSpecId to executable inputs and independent oracle versions before running. Preserve all original parent-table assertions alongside fixed additional children. Keep explicit parent-table-remainder units for the eleven additive splits; aggregates cannot become PASS from child subset evidence. Resolve special fixture requirements below without weakening positive capabilities or tolerances. This artifact does not certify existing narrow fixtures as complete.

basis: v1.2 §9.1 parents aggregate only and G8 final union
decisions.missing: The text does not define whether additive fixed children replace all parent table assertions, how profile/participant/build dimensions affect the denominator, or a machine key.
decisions.recommendation: Keep 91 parent aggregates and 84 fixed references plus U01/U02; only generated executable cells count. A caseKey is an internal fixture unit, not a new acceptance category. Split-only parents aggregate children; additive parents also require a parent-table-remainder caseKey. Build profile and worker count are explicit key dimensions; named performance profile and human cohort are caseKey dimensions. Aggregate fixed WASM-13-AIR-ST and C28-SENSOR-CCD are not executable or double-counted. WASM-15 aggregates P01–P07. Do not merge or remove cells without a reviewed version change and retained prior contract.

decisions.blocks: specific BIZ07/AG execution, not unrelated implementation
decisions.missing: Three real first-time participants, coordinator/time/device allocation and the five independent Agent task contexts have not been assigned. The source requires three participants total, not three participants on each platform.
decisions.recommendation: Keep separate BIZ07 device/UX cells on Chrome/Android/iOS and one human-cohort cell requiring three non-implementers with at least two first orders unaided within 90 seconds. Coordinator records actual device allocation without conflating this cohort with all-device QA. AG tasks require fresh non-implementer contexts and retained prompt/docs/tarball/failures/intervention records. No person, session, time or authorization is invented.

mtTargetRecommendations.recommendation: Retain positive low-level native MT target for the proposed Node rows.
basis: §11.1 Node release WASM and WASM-13 matrix
§11.3 A06 mode comparison; §7.3 independent MT build
mtTargetRecommendations.rationale: Node is an independent worker/bootstrap/lifetime path and verifies real release WASM without claiming to render or run the browser-only main entry. Successful ST says nothing about pthread startup/cleanup.
requiredVerification: pinned Node/V8/platform and actual WASM SIMD/shared-memory/worker support
real MT2/MT3/MT4 where each definition requires them, pool-ready-before-world and bounded worker teardown
native-only fixture scope, never substitute Node for browser CSP, rendering or performance
mtTargetRecommendations.impactIfUnresolved: Keep all Node positive MT candidate cells NOT_RUN/BLOCKED; early ST/host work continues. Any target removal requires a new reviewed capability/scope record, never an inferred unsupported label.

mtTargetRecommendations.recommendation: Retain primary positive browser MT target.
mtTargetRecommendations.rationale: Chrome is already the explicit host-browser class and the initial desktop performance resource. This is the first full browser path for MT loading, strict CSP, visible frame cost and worker cleanup.
requiredVerification: real pinned Chrome host on authorized isolated origin
actual COOP/COEP/SAB/Worker/pool capability and resource response headers
MT2/MT4 shared behavior and complete-count MT3 admission/repeatability where required
matched positive MT plus injected failure/multi rejection/auto-ST-fallback paths
mtTargetRecommendations.impactIfUnresolved: T24 host-MT scope and dependent advanced acceptance remain unproved; do not replace positive MT with a missing-isolation negative test.

mtTargetRecommendations.recommendation: Retain positive Firefox MT candidate until explicit platform review.
mtTargetRecommendations.rationale: A Chrome result cannot establish Firefox worker startup, shared-memory scheduling, CSP, event transport or shutdown. The plan retains Firefox as required; no source excludes it from MT.
requiredVerification: real pinned Firefox/OS and permitted isolated test origin
actual SIMD/SAB/Worker/pool path and all proposed public behavior fixtures
independent real MT counts and disposal evidence
mtTargetRecommendations.impactIfUnresolved: Keep its proposed MT cells required candidates; failure or missing host is not permission to narrow the target class.

basis: §11.1 real Safari separate from Playwright WebKit

requiredVerification: real macOS/Safari version and authorized isolated origin
actual SIMD/shared memory/SAB/Worker/pool behavior, not feature-string inference alone
strict CSP, repeatability and bounded close on the actual target
mtTargetRecommendations.impactIfUnresolved: Retain pending positive cells; only a documented scope/capability decision with preserved old obligations may change them, not unavailable hardware.

requiredVerification: exact device/Android/WebView version and embedding app/origin configuration
approved access and actual isolated SIMD/SAB/Worker/pool execution
touch/background/resume/close, worker cleanup and applicable 30-minute thermal/performance observations
mtTargetRecommendations.impactIfUnresolved: Retain all positive MT cells and performance candidates; device absence cannot turn the target into an unsupported negative case. ST device work remains independently executable.

mtTargetRecommendations.rationale: The plan requires a real iOS class and leaves COLD-MT applicability unfrozen. Preserving positive candidates avoids treating a simulator, missing device or presumed browser limitation as a scope decision. Compatibility alone does not invent a general iOS 60fps promise.
requiredVerification: actual SIMD/shared memory/SAB/Worker/pool capability and MT execution
